hero.subtitle: Ipuratifomu yakazara ine webhu uye nharembozha yekugovera, kutengesa, logistics, kutenga, inventory, mari nezvimwe.

products_block.title: A [[yakazara ecosystem] yenzvimbo yega yega yebhizinesi rako
products_block.aside: Yakabatanidzwa mhinduro dzinoshanda pamwe chete kukupa kutonga kwakazara, kushanda nesimba uye kukura kukuru.

products_page.title: Zvigadzirwa zvinomwe, [[kuvhiya kamwe]]
products_page.text: Chigadzirwa chimwe nechimwe chinogadzirisa nzvimbo. Pamwe chete vanogovana vatengi, stock, maodha uye kubhadhara.

fullvendor.card: Main platform yekutengeserana manejimendi uye kugovera.
fullvendor.lead: Pakati pebasa rako rekutengesa: maodha, mitengo, stock uye vatengi munzvimbo imwechete.
fullvendor.about: FullVendor inotsiva maspredishiti akasununguka uye masisitimu. Kubva pano maodha anobuda, inventory inobvunzurudzwa, portfolio yevatengi inochengetwa uye nhamba dzezuva dzinotariswa. Iyo yakasara ye ecosystem inobatanidza kune iyi base.

benefits.title: Imwe data master
benefits.text: Vatengi, zvigadzirwa nemitengo zvakagovaniswa nekutengesa, dura uye mari.

benefits.title: Clear zuva nezuva kushanda
benefits.text: Maodha, kutenga uye stock inomira kugara mumafaira akasiyana.

benefits.title: Mishumo yekusarudza

erp.lead: Kutonga uye mari, zvinoenderana nezvinotengeswa uye zvinounzwa.
erp.about: FullVendor ERP inovhara accounting, electronic invoicing, payrolls, fixed assets uye multi-company. Zvinotora basa rekutengesa uye rinoshandura kuita zvinyorwa, risiti uye zvinyorwa zvinogona kushandiswa nenharaunda yemari.

benefits.title: Yakabatanidzwa accounting

unify.title: Maitiro ekubatanidza kugovera kuita imwechete system
unify.summary: Chii chekuisa pamwe chete kutanga kana kutengesa, dura uye kuunganidza zvinogara mumafaira akasiyana.
points: Tanga nevatengi, zvigadzirwa uye mitengo: ivo mudzidzisi anoshandiswa nemunhu wese.
Batanidza odha nestock usati wawedzera mamwe maapplication.
Inoyera nhamba iri nyore: mirairo inozadzikiswa pasina kudzoreredza fomu.

offline.title: Kutengesa kunomanikidza kushanda pasina Indaneti
offline.summary: Chii chaunoda kubva kune yekuraira app kuitira kuti mutengesi arege kumira nekuda kwechiratidzo.
points: Iyo catalog uye chikwama zvinofanirwa kunge zviri parunhare, kwete mugore chete.
Kurongeka kunochengetwa pamudziyo uye kuiswa kana network yadzoka.

warehouse.title: Warehouse ine barcode, isina bepa
warehouse.summary: Maitiro ekuenda kubva kune yakadhindwa runyorwa kuenda kwakasimbiswa kunhonga pafoni.
points: Gamuchira uchipesana nekuraira kwekutenga, kwete nekurangarira.
Simbisa chinhu chimwe nechimwe paunopatsanura. Chipembenene chinocheka mukoridho.
Iyo yekutumirwa inogadziridza stock iyo mutengesi anoona.

finance.title: Kuunganidzwa kunoenderana nekutengesa
finance.summary: Sei mutengesi achifanira kuona chikwereti chemutengi asati atora imwe odha.
points: Kushanya ndiyo nguva yakanakisisa yekuunganidza, kana chikwereti chikaonekwa.
Kutengesa uye mari zvinofanirwa kutarisa kune mutengi mumwe chete.
Chirevo chezuva nezuva chakanyanya kukosha kupfuura kunonoka kuvhara.

legal.privacy_intro: Iyi mutemo inotsanangura zvatinoita nedata raunosiya mumafomu pane ino saiti.

privacy.title: Ndeapi data yatinounganidza
privacy.text: Kana iwe ukakumbira demo kana kutinyorera kwatiri, isu tinochengetedza zita, kambani, email, nhamba dzerunhare kana iwe ukazviratidzira, nyika, saizi yechikwata, chigadzirwa chekufarira uye meseji. Isu tinorekodha zvakare zuva, mutauro wepeji uye IP kero, kudzivirira kutumira zvisizvo.

privacy.title: Tinozvishandisirei?
privacy.text: Isu tinoshandisa iyi data chete kukupindura iwe, kuronga demo uye kugadzirira chikumbiro chekutengesa. Isu hativatengese kana kuvapa kune runyorwa rwevechitatu mapato.

privacy.title: Vanochengeterwa kupi uye kwenguva yakareba sei?
privacy.text: Zvikumbiro zvinochengetwa pasevha yesaiti ino. Isu tinozvichengeta kwenguva inodiwa kuti tikushumire iwe uye kutengeserana kutevera, uye tinozvidzima kana iwe ukatikumbira kana pazvisingachadikanwa.

privacy.title: Kodzero dzako
privacy.text: Iwe unogona kukumbira kuwana, kururamisa kana kudzima data rako kubva pafomu rekuonana, richiratidza mumeseji. Kana iyo kambani ikaburitsa email pane ino webhusaiti, unogona zvakare kunyora ipapo.

legal.terms_intro: Aya mamiriro anoshanda pakushandiswa kweiyi FullVendor yekutumira saiti.

terms.title: Commercial information
terms.text: Zvinyorwa, muenzaniso nhamba dzedashibhodhi uye tsananguro zvinosuma chikuva. Ivo vanogona kugadziridzwa kana chigadzirwa chachinja uye chisiri chakavharwa chinopihwa.

terms.title: Iyo demo haisi chibvumirano
terms.text: Kuendesa fomu hakuite chisungo chekutenga kana kuchengetedza mutengo. Chero kontrakiti inobvumiranwa zvakasiyana, mukunyora, nehukuru hwayo uye mamiriro.

terms.title: Site content
terms.text: Iyo FullVendor trademark, mazita echigadzirwa uye zviri mumapeji aya ndezvevaridzi vazvo. Havagoni kukopa kuti varatidze chimwe chigadzirwa.

terms.title: Kushandiswa kunogamuchirwa
terms.text: Usashandise mafomu kuendesa ruzivo rwenhema, spam kana zviri kunze kwemutemo. Tinogona kufuratira zvikumbiro zvisingaenderane nehurukuro chaiyo yebhizinesi.
